system.description:
Prerequisites: Intermediate Animalism, Basic Chimerstry. Lets a Ravnos operating in Kuei-jin (Cathayan) territory disguise her supernatural nature as that of a yin-aspected Kuei-jin rather than Kindred, defeating any power or sense that would otherwise detect her true nature. This does not grant any Eastern Discipline or Dharma access.

System: The Ravnos spends one Willpower and one Blood Point, then rolls Manipulation + Subterfuge (difficulty 6); the successes rolled are the number of successes an onlooker's detection power must overcome to see through the disguise. The effect lasts one night.

Costs 15 experience points (dot system) / 7 Experience Traits (MET) to learn.

MET: The Ravnos spends one Willpower Trait and one Blood Trait to invoke the disguise until sunrise; during that time she registers to supernatural senses as a yin-aspected Cathayan, not as Kindred.
